lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Fe2O4 (reduced formula LiFeO2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Li each adopt octahedral coordination, surrounded by six O neighbors, while O centers have four geometric neighbors (three Fe and one Li). Corner-sharing between Fe and Li octahedra is observed, along with edge-sharing between like Fe–Fe and Li–Li octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
